answer: Prayers & Duties >> Salah (Prayer) Question ID: 150936 Country: India Title: Ruling about Sunnah Muwakkidah salah during a journey Question: If a person is a traveler, should he pray sunnah muwakkidah & sunnah ghair-muwakkidah? I heard that one should pray sunnah muwakkidah, if a person is not in hurry (he has sufficient time) & leave sunnah ghair-muwakkidah. But one of friend is telling no need to pray sunnah muwakkidah. In case my friend is right what about sunnah prayer of Fajr? Answer ID: 150936 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 729/566/D=8/1438) What you heard is correct i.e. if you have enough time then offer sunnah muwakkidah and if you are in hurry and on the way or in train or bus then leave it. The same ruling shall apply to the Fajr sunnah. However, if he missed sunnah muwakkidah while there was time then he shall not be sinful as sunnah is exempted during a journey. The intention of your friend would be that when there is no sin by leaving it then there is no need to offer it but it did not come into his mind yet if he offers then it shall bring reward. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
